fields.objective: Create a reusable offline issue draft preview.
fields.scope:
Scope:
- Render a local preview.

Non-goals:
- No GitHub writes.
fields.prior-scope-review: Reviewed #599 and #600; this extends the canonical issue-label architecture.
fields.validation:
Tests:
- focused pytest
- aggregate validation

Docs:
- not applicable
fields.acceptance:
Acceptance criteria:
- [ ] Preview is deterministic.

Definition of done:
- [ ] Validation passes.
safety: No direct push to main, automatic merge, or autonomous issue closure is authorized.
No production, governed-field, source-of-truth, sharing, or external-system write is authorized without explicit approval.
Final implementation reporting will include files changed, tests run, docs updated, blockers, handoffs, and remaining risks.
